fieldValues.title: protocol_run_service does not validate protocol_id against installed Protocols
fieldValues.summary: create_run accepts any protocol_id/protocol_version string pair and stores it verbatim; it never checks that a Protocol with that id and version is actually installed via protocol_service. A run can therefore be created, advanced and completed against a protocol_id that does not exist.
fieldValues.rationale: This was observed while writing #977's MCP tools, but it is pre-existing protocol_run_service behaviour untouched by that unit — not a regression #977 introduced, and not #977's issue to fix (its scope was the MCP adapter, not the service's referential integrity). Left as-is here rather than silently worked around: a future unit that needs run-to-protocol integrity (e.g. repo validate reporting a dangling protocol_id on a run, or the CLI/MCP create verbs rejecting an unknown protocol_id up front) should treat this as its starting evidence rather than rediscovering it from scratch. Applies to any future work in protocol_run_service.create_run, and to programme-unit-walk runs specifically if a worker ever typos a protocol_id when starting one — the run will silently exist rather than fail fast.
